summary: Python 2.7 was the last release in the 2.x series. It coincided with and backported features from Python 3.1. In 2014, the PSF announced support until 2020, encouraging migration to Python 3. Support ended on 1 January 2020; a final release, 2.7.18, shipped in April 2020 with critical bug fixes. Python 2.7 was the dominant version for a decade and remains in legacy deployments.
notes: Unsupported since 2020-01-01. Last micro 2.7.18. The official end of Python 2. Hundreds of thousands of projects relied on 2.7; migration took years. 2to3 and six helped bridge the gap.
